Inventory.title: Inventory
Inventory.subtitle: Tableware and table supplies: how many of each you need, how many you have, and what got broken or lost.
Inventory.cardLowHint: Reserve below minimum or not enough for the tables
Inventory.stockExplain: "Have" is the total in the restaurant (on tables + in storage). "Needed for tables" is what it takes to fully set every table. "Spare" = have − needed; a minus means you're short.
Inventory.zeroStockHint: No quantity entered yet for {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}. Count everything once in "Count" or record a "Stock in" — then the overview is accurate and waiters can report breakage.
Inventory.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? If it has history, the item will be archived and kept in reports.
Inventory.starterAdded: Added {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}. Now enter the quantity of each — the easiest way is a "Count".
Inventory.emptyText: Add the list of items your restaurant uses. The starter list has 21 items for a Chinese restaurant (chopsticks, tea bowls, teapots, bowls…), each with how many go on a table. Quantities start at 0 — you'll enter them next.
Inventory.emptyTextNoStarter: No active items. Add one with the "New item" button.
Inventory.emptyHint: Then enter the real quantity of each item: count it in "Count" or record a "Stock in".
Inventory.fNormHint: E.g. tea bowl — 1 per seat, teapot — 1 per table. For items that don't go on tables (e.g. kitchen tools), leave both at 0.
Inventory.fMinReserveHint: If storage (beyond what's on tables) drops below this, you'll see "Running low".
Inventory.fUnitPriceHint: Used to calculate the loss amount. Optional.
Inventory.fQuantityNew: How many you have now in total (pcs)
Inventory.fQuantityNewHint: On tables and in storage together. If you don't know, leave 0 and enter it later in a "Count".
Inventory.fQuantityEditHint: Normally the quantity changes via "Stock in", "Broken" and "Count". If you change it here, a "Manual fix" is recorded in the history.
Inventory.fPurchasePriceHint: If entered, the item's price is updated too.
Inventory.lossDone: "{name}": loss of {qty} pcs recorded. Left on record: {left} pcs.
Inventory.fResponsibleHint: Who broke it or who is responsible — for records only.
Inventory.zeroStockLoss: 0 pcs on record — a manager must first enter the real quantity ("Stock in" or "Count").
Inventory.staffIntro: If a dish or table item gets broken, lost or becomes unusable, record it here. You will be listed as responsible.
Inventory.staffNoItems: The inventory hasn't been set up yet. Please contact a manager.
Inventory.staffStockHint: If it says "Not enough: only 0 pcs on record", a manager must enter the real quantities first ("Count").
Inventory.tablesExplain: The count on each table is calculated from the item norm: per-seat norm × seats + per-table norm. Change norms by editing the item in "Stock", and halls and tables in "Halls & tables".
Inventory.noTables: No active tables. First add a hall and tables in "Halls & tables".
Inventory.noNorms: Items don't have "how many per seat / per table" set yet — edit the item under "Items".
Inventory.noItemsForTables: The inventory is empty. First add items following the guide in "Overview".
Inventory.grandTotalsShortHint: Red border — the total on record isn't enough even for the tables.
Inventory.tableEmpty: No items set to go on tables
Inventory.countIntro: Physically count all items — on tables and in reserve — and compare with the quantity on record (e.g. once a month). When completed, the recorded quantity is set to the counted one, and any shortage is counted as a loss.
Inventory.countExpectedHint: "On record" is how many the system says you should have. Type what you actually counted under "Counted" — the difference shows right away: green tick — matches, red — missing. Rows left empty stay unchanged.
Inventory.countCompleteHint: Taking a while? Press "Save" and continue later.
Inventory.countCompleteConfirm:
Finish the count?

For the {counted} counted items (of {total}), the number on record becomes what you counted, and the differences go to the history. Uncounted items stay unchanged. This can't be undone.
Inventory.countCancelConfirm: Cancel the count? The numbers you typed will be discarded; records won't change.
Inventory.countCompleted: Stock count completed: {adjusted} items adjusted. Shortage: {pieces} pcs ({sum}), surplus: {surplus} pcs.
Inventory.countNoDiff: No difference — everything is in place.
Inventory.errNotReady: Couldn't load inventory data. The database may not be updated yet — an administrator needs to run "prisma db push".

guide.title: Where to start?
guide.lead: The inventory is set up in 3 steps. Do it once — after that you only record stock-ins and breakage.
guide.s1Text: What the restaurant uses: chopsticks, tea bowls, teapots… Add the starter list in one click, then check how many of each go on a table.
guide.s1Done: The list has {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}
guide.s2Title: Enter how many you have now
guide.s2Text: Count everything once and write it down in "Count". After that, add new purchases with "Stock in".
guide.s3Text: When something breaks or goes missing, record it right away (waiters can too, from their phones). Do a count once a month.

tb.how: How it's calculated: each item says "how many per seat" and "how many per table". E.g. if a tea bowl is 1 per seat, a 10-seat table needs 10 tea bowls. Change this by editing the item under "Items".

cnt.step1Text: Press "Start count" — the list of all items opens.
cnt.step2Text: Count each item (on tables and in storage) and type the number. Empty rows stay unchanged. Taking a while? Save and continue later.
cnt.step3Text: Press "Finish" — the number on record becomes what you counted. Anything missing is recorded as a loss.
